BAFS is fully ready to provide Sustainable 
Aviation Fuel (SAF) refueling services 
with international standards.
Supported Thai Vietjet Air’s flight on the 
Bangkok–Phu Quoc route, 
in collaboration with OR for SAF supply.
Successfully refueled with SAF using a 
Dispenser vehicle, 
demonstrating BAFS’s operational readiness 
and staff expertise.
CAAT targets SAF 
usage of 0.5%–1% in 2026 and 1% in 2027 , and 
will introduce a voluntary Carbon Surcharge for 
international flights starting January 2026 .
